en.topic_title: ‘Main culprits,’ ignored complaints, and needed reforms: Takeaways from the independent probe into the Tai Po fire
en.topic_summary:
Almost a year after a deadly blaze killed 168 people and left thousands homeless at Tai Po’s Wang Fuk Court, an independent inquiry has produced a comprehensive report into the tragedy, identifying the “culprits,” making wide-ranging recommendations, and mourning the lives lost.



(From left to right) Chief Secretary Eric Chan, Chief Executive John Lee and Financial Secretary Paul Chan bow in apology on October 29, 2026 over the deadly 2025 Wang Fuk Court blaze. Photo: Kyle La
